page.layout: One page of text, single column. Running head at top with page number 28 at left. Main text above a centred heading "DIXI." Below the heading a faint show-through of the reverse page (not transcribed). No marginal notes.

main_text.p: sane inter famosas Thaidas castam Susannam aut Penelopen habere, quàm hujus commatis Politicum, interquè Alcibiadem solito civiliorem, & Dionem solito inciviliorem, Cleomenem aliquem moribus civilem, gerentem se πολιτικῶς, Ciceronis verbo, hoc est, ut ego interpretor, nec Gnathonicè, nec Thrasonicè, verùm Thrasybulicè, jungendo exemplo Thrasybuli τῷ θεάσει τὴν βουλὴν, ut absque adulationis fuco, sive Gnathonismo, ita absque jactantiæ vento, sive Thrasonismo.
main_text.head: DIXI.

page.notes: The Greek phrases are printed in Greek letters; the transcription of the Greek is approximate. The faint text below the heading is show-through from the reverse page and was left out. The printed heading reads "DIXI." in the original page layout.
